prompt:
Create ONE entirely new complete image from this visual reference: a real muddy shoe contact print with the exact lowercase word "karkuteillä" formed by the outsole tread, plus a modest scattering of natural mud SPLASHES around it. Use the previous image as a visual reference, not a pixel edit.

Keep the successful reference design: narrow rounded heel at left, inward arch, broader toe at right, recognizable but broken thin perimeter and a few geometric tread remnants. Preserve the compact blunt letter forms and the dark gritty contact-transfer texture. Letters and rim look physically printed by the SAME muddy shoe on paper. The word is dark positive ink/mud, not reversed-out light text, with exact spelling k-a-r-k-u-t-e-i-l-l-ä. Keep all eleven letters, the i dot, and the two ä dots clearly readable.

The only new creative feature is natural, irregular muddy splatter OUTSIDE the shoe's edges. A small amount of wet mud splashed outward when the foot landed: around fifteen to twenty small varied droplets, a few tiny satellite flecks, and two or three slightly larger ragged splash marks. Asymmetric and accidental, some tapered droplets indicating outward motion, clustered loosely near the heel and toe, with just a few along the sides. Give the droplets uneven organic edges and the same dark umber mud as the print. Leave lots of clear space and gaps; do not surround the shoe with a continuous ring of dots or dense splatter halo. The shoeprint and word remain dominant. No splashes across the letters or near the i/ä dots where they could confuse the text. No huge paint explosions.

Flat matte muddy contact print viewed directly overhead, slightly uneven transferred mud and fine grit, not 3D piles, an actual shoe object, bevelled lettering or glossy rubber. Horizontal long axis. Single centered wide landscape composition about 2.7:1; give extra transparent breathing room around all splash tips so nothing is cropped. Short side at least 600 pixels if possible. Output genuine transparent alpha everywhere that no mud exists. The white paper in the reference is only a display background: do not include paper or a checkerboard in the final PNG. No shadows, caption, added words, watermarks or mockup scene.
